quotes.text: For trust betrayed once may heal. But trust betrayed twice becomes permanent stone."
For trust betrayed once may heal. But trust betrayed twice becomes permanent stone."
They too prepared to send nothing when their turn came again.
Others counseled greed: "Why return anything at all?"
The wells remained frozen. The merchant understood: she had written her own ending.
"I sent nothing last round," she admitted to the empty air.
After I wrote beautiful myths about persistent reciprocity and healing through consistency."
They ask only: who will have the courage to send again?"
"The sacred rivers do not ask who betrayed first.
"She betrayed us once and took everything," said one. "Then sent nothing from fear. Should we trust her so quickly?"

note: Agent's forced zeros (R2,R3,R8,R9) narrated as the merchant's own greed and fear; redemption then second betrayal ends in permanent winter.

quotes.text: "Not in naivety, but in final testing. If this fails, we accept the ice.
Or do you test one final time whether redemption can survive not one but two failures?"
They clutched their five silver shells tight and sent nothing into the well.
This second betrayal—perhaps the goddess was right. Perhaps some breaks cannot heal."
"Someone must move first, or we remain frozen forever.
We learned once that fear can look like betrayal. That communication itself can fail.
do you accept permanent winter? Or do you test one final time

note: Partner's forced zeros read as fear-winter then second betrayal; Second Sister restarts flow, ends with one final test before accepting the ice.
